items.description: Pneumatic launch tube for C-130/KC-135 and S0

notes: Active collaborative engineering phase with Ultra PCS/USAF on pneumatic launcher design. Last contact 2026-02-25; Tracy Harris pursuing Royal Navy interest and UK-US funding pathways. Dan Prendergast (Asana assignee), Jack Elston, Maciej Stachura, and Beck Cotter involved in technical discussions on UAV dimensions, tube interface (Sonobuoy A vs. CLT), ejection velocity, and acceleration requirements. No purchase order or QBO invoice yet — purely pre-sales technical phase.
